name: Black Hole raises Melt Reality and Unmake damage by 15% against slowed enemies (#786)
contract: #786: Black Hole 707557 reads 'Increases the damage of Chromatic Shard, Melt Reality and Unmake by $s1% against slowed enemies.' Its only effect is aura 112 with EffectMiscValue 20007 (the class-mask aura-state damage selector the core already converts to aura 303 for Ravager, Hunting Tactics and others), EffectMiscValueB 26, EffectBasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = 15 and EffectSpellClassMask [0, 33554944, 0] in family 28, which is exactly Melt Reality's word-1 bit 512 (806335 and ranks) plus Unmake's word-1 bit 33554432 (503784 and ranks). State 26 means a slowed target on every client record that carries it: Reckless Assault 804610, The Time Has Come 572879 and Shard of True Ice 805425 all describe the same selector as 'against slowed enemies/targets', and Felsworn's Reckless Assault is already scored as SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED. Before the fix the effect was never converted and AuraStateType has no state 26, so the bonus never applied. The query is the native spell_damage_done on each DoT's periodic path (Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone folds aura 303 into the done multiplier), against two identical dummies of which only one carries Slow 31589 (aura 33 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED). Before Black Hole is learned the slow changes nothing; after it, both masked DoTs gain exactly 15% against the slowed dummy only, and Timerend 801291 (word-1 bit 16777216, outside the mask) gains nothing. Chromatic Shard is named by the tooltip but is not in the mask and is not asserted.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The other dummy is not slowed
Unmake periodic damage against the unslowed dummy
Melt Reality periodic damage against the unslowed dummy
Timerend periodic damage against the unslowed dummy
Without Black Hole the slow alone leaves Unmake unchanged
Black Hole raises Unmake by 15% against the slowed dummy
Black Hole raises Melt Reality by 15% against the slowed dummy
Unmake gains nothing against the unslowed dummy
Timerend, outside Black Hole's mask, gains nothing against the slowed dummy
